acceptance_by_experiment.experiment1: Reject all three corrections. This is a narrow elimination result, not evidence against gap-task interference or an information limit.
acceptance_by_experiment.experiment2: No adoption. Expanded measured fitting improves aggregate/current accuracy, but heterogeneity and new2-profile deterioration prevent a general support-adequacy conclusion. The physical-description arm does not consistently improve predictions.
acceptance_by_experiment.experiment3: Reject this implementation for promotion, retain bounded recurrence as research. Content improves on flags/age and framewise predictions, including distinct regimes. It does not uniformly beat same-span controls and fails stable-sign, optimism, retreat and farther-stable safeguards.

experiment1_leverage: The user's criticism is substantially right. Frozen gaps alone forced all-frame AND boundary errors above their targets, even with perfect current predictions. I should have required that floor calculation before prioritizing the experiment and explicitly excluded endpoint attainment from its acceptance possibilities. It was not useless—it rejected specific current-head corrections—but its scientific leverage was limited, and it should not be repeated.
supported_diagnosis: Observation erasure/extrapolation is now an evidenced major system bottleneck: only49.10% clean and approximately12% of1% frames pass the measured gate, while gap errors dominate. This does not establish absence of useful information in rejected waveforms.
Expanded fitting population matters, but does not solve conversion. Its benefit cannot be attributed solely to structural diversity because fitting contributions also change.

The physical counterfactual is especially incomplete under noise: replacement covers approximately84.4% of clean evaluation slots but only26–27% at1%. Aggregate38.402% coverage obscures that distinction. Even the stronger clean intervention mixes instantaneous physical and finite-window effective descriptions; its failure cannot exonerate extraction or prove conversion is the sole problem.

GRU results support useful bounded measured content, not specifically temporal ordering: same-span pooling frequently matches or beats it. The new distinct-regime gains revise the earlier four-design conclusion, without establishing recurrence-specific superiority.

next_mechanism_test.name: Diagnostic-only gate-erasure ablation
next_mechanism_test.hypotheses: Useful measured modal content is discarded by the forecast gate versus rejected windows yielding no transferable information through the existing extractor.
next_mechanism_test.intervention: Keep the expanded-support folds, existing383ms-reset GRU,174-feature dictionary, calibration, optimizer/checkpoint policy and seeds fixed. Compare current feature-zeroing with retaining genuinely finite pre-forecast-gate174 estimates in forecast-rejected slots. Keep original observation flags/age and every qualification decision unchanged. Commanded, saturated, invalid and genuinely unavailable estimates remain excluded/masked. Add one same-width shuffled-rejected-content control, with physical-source permutations consistent across paired noise views and confined to partitions.
next_mechanism_test.boundary: This is an offline representation test, not permission to call failed-gate observations current or reliable. Rejected-slot predictions remain unqualified. Do not change denominators, expiry, aperture or gates. Prerequisite: pre-gate feature extraction must distinguish real finite estimates from manufactured fallback values.
next_mechanism_test.success: Require real retained content to beat both zeroing and shuffled controls on original-denominator gap and boundary errors across primary families, without current-boundary, sign, optimism, retreat or farther-stable regressions. Report progress toward the unchanged .010/.015 overall and .005/.010 boundary targets; partial improvement is not qualification.
next_mechanism_test.outcomes: Success prioritizes measured information retention/extraction and subsequent independent qualification—not another converter sweep. Failure rejects this retention mechanism; it does not prove raw-waveform nonidentifiability. Examine clean versus noisy and no-valid-slot histories separately, preserving totals. This has greater leverage than another marginal feature because it addresses the majority population currently deprived of response features.

campaign_limits: No arm earns promotion or endpoint credit; measured improvements remain legitimate experimental findings. The acquisition envelope should govern the next mechanism decision, not be retrospectively narrowed to improve scores. Independent physical/model-form validation remains prerequisite to credibility and eventual qualification, but its absence does not itself explain these within-simulator errors.
